c: Pick a template from Network or Server standard changes.
say: Find the standard change in the catalog, under network or server.

c: The description and plans come from the template and are read-only; complete the group, the justification and the risk analysis.
say: The description and the plans come from the template and can't be changed. Complete the assignment group, the justification, and the risk analysis.

c: Submit: it is approved at once.
say: Submit it. A standard change is approved at once.

c: It goes to Scheduled; carry on with the implementation.
say: It goes to scheduled. Carry on with the implementation.

c: Doing the same normal change often? Propose it as a standard change template.
say: If you do the same normal change often, propose it as a standard change template. The change manager approves proposals.
